newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai June car sales drop 24.3 percent yr/yr-Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai June car sales drop 24.3 percent yr/yr-Toyota.

text.p: Sales of passenger cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand dropped 24.3 percent in June to 36,503 units from 48,220 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Wednesday.
Cummulative vehicle sales in the first six months fell 14.5 percent to 248,185 units from 290,171 in the same period in the previous year, it added in a statement.
Toyota cars topped Thai vehicle sales in June with a 34.9 percent market share on sales of 12,735, compared with 13,241 in the same month a year ago, it said.
Isuzu Motors vehicles came second with 7,493 units sold in June, representing a 20.5 percent share, against 8,824 in the same month last year.
Toyota passenger car sales in the month totalled 5,361 compared with 4,617 in the same month a year earlier.
Honda Motor was second with 4,400 sold in the month, or 30.7 percent of the passenger market, against 3,579 a year earlier, it said.
